name: visible-alpha-diagnostic-v1
role: functional coverage, not human difficulty prediction
state_access: current submitted geometry and visible permission colors; no future spawns or hidden-target aim
action_policy: activate visible sources when an invalid target is visible; then shoot currently hittable targets; reload an empty declared magazine
limitations: no reaction-time or aim-noise human model
features smaller than grid spacing may be missed
no physical gun or display latency measurement
